requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.receive_messages method is returning a coroutine instead of an AsyncIterator, causing TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must return an AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]] that can be used in 'async for' loops. It should properly yield parsed message data asynchronously.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.disconnect method is not properly closing the stdin stream in streaming mode, causing 'close' to have been called zero times in context manager tests.
requirement.contract: The disconnect method must properly close the stdin stream and ensure cleanup of all resources when called, particularly in streaming mode where stdin is kept open for send_request operations.

requirement.description: The ClaudeSDKClient.receive_messages method is not properly handling the async iterator from transport.receive_messages(), leading to incorrect return types and async iteration issues.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages method must properly await and yield from the transport's receive_messages async iterator to ensure correct async iteration behavior.

requirement.description: The _stream_to_stdin method has issues with resource cleanup and proper handling of the stdin stream lifecycle in streaming mode.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin method must properly manage the stdin stream lifecycle and ensure it's correctly closed or maintained based on the mode (streaming vs string).

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query method is not properly handling the transport lifecycle when close_stdin_after_prompt is set to True.
requirement.contract: The process_query method must ensure proper cleanup of transport resources when close_stdin_after_prompt is True, especially for one-shot queries.
